desc:
☁️ Welcome to Steal A Cloud!

How to play:
☁️ Steal clouds from guardians
💥 Burst clouds and collect pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
📈 Upgrade your turbine and base
⏫ Use the turbine to boost your velocity
🔓 Unlock new biomes with more velocity
🥊 Trap and fight other players for better clouds

⏰ Brew your clouds and earn money offline!

🎮 Supports all platforms!
